1.t: Read: In the name of thy Lord Who createth,

3.t: Read: And thy Lord is the Most Bounteous,

5.t: Teacheth man that which he knew not.

6.t: Nay, but verily man is rebellious

8.t: Lo! unto thy Lord is the return.

9.t: Hast thou seen him who dissuadeth

11.t: Hast thou seen if he relieth on the guidance (of Allah)

13.t: Hast thou seen if he denieth (Allah's guidance) and is froward?

14.t: Is he then unaware that Allah seeth?

15.t: Nay, but if he cease not We will seize him by the forelock -

17.t: Then let him call upon his henchmen!

18.t: We will call the guards of hell.

19.t: Nay, Obey not thou him. But prostrate thyself, and draw near (unto Allah).
